title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Tenure Exit Schedule
content:
The exit-fee percentage of the early termination fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement follows the tenure exit schedule, which counts the whole months from the go-live date to today.

| Whole months from go-live to today | Exit-fee percentage |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | the tier's early termination fee percentage less 20 points |
| 24 to 35 | the tier's early termination fee percentage less 10 points |
| fewer than 24 | the tier's early termination fee percentage as it is |

A whole month between two dates is counted only once the later date reaches the same day of the month as the earlier one, and a month window of N months ending today takes the entries dated fewer than N whole months before today.

**Hypothetical illustrations, tier percentage 75.**
- Go-live 2022-06-20, today 2025-06-19: the 20th was last reached on 2025-05-20, so 35 whole months; the percentage is 65.
- Today 2025-06-20: 36 whole months; the percentage is 55.
- Go-live 2024-01-10, today 2025-12-01: 22 whole months; the percentage stays 75.
